# Anoushkrit Goel - Complete Technical Portfolio & Research Knowledge Base

## Overview
Anoushkrit Goel is an Applied Scientist, Researcher, and Entrepreneur with 7+ years of experience specializing in 3D Spatial AI (point cloud sequence modeling, B-Spline tokenization, transformer architectures), Medical Imaging & Neuroimaging (Diffusion MRI white matter tractography), Vector AI & Document OCR, and Reinforcement Learning.

Current Role: Research Engineer 2 at Attentive.AI
Education: M.Tech (by Research) in Intelligent Systems at IIT Mandi (GPA: 9.47/10), B.Tech in Electronics Engineering with Minor in Design from Shiv Nadar University (GPA: 7.61/10).

---

## Peer-Reviewed Publications & Research Papers

### 1. TrackletGPT: A GPT architecture for White Matter Segmentation
- Venue: IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI 2026, London, UK) — Rank: A
- Authors: Anoushkrit Goel, Dr. Aditya Nigam, Dr. Arnav Bhavsar
- Code URL: https://github.com/anoushkrit/TrackletGPT
- Page URL: https://anoushkritgoel.com/projects/trackletgpt
- Abstract & Method: TrackletGPT introduces a novel 3D point cloud tokenization scheme for fiber tractography. Streamlines are decomposed into continuous B-Spline sub-segments ('tracklets'). Geometric curvature parameters are tokenized into discrete representations, enabling a decoder-only GPT transformer to pretrain on tracklet completion and dual-masking.
- BibTeX:
```bibtex
@inproceedings{goel2026trackletgpt,
  title={TrackletGPT: A GPT architecture for White Matter Segmentation},
  author={Goel, Anoushkrit and Nigam, Aditya and Bhavsar, Arnav},
  booktitle={IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI)},
  year={2026}
}
```

### 2. TractRLFusion: Reinforcement Learning and Fusion Networks for Diffusion MRI
- Venue: IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI 2026, London, UK)
- Authors: Anoushkrit Goel, Dr. Aditya Nigam, Dr. Arnav Bhavsar
- Page URL: https://anoushkritgoel.com/projects/tractrlfusion
- Abstract & Method: Combines reinforcement learning policy gradient algorithms with multi-modal neural fusion networks to track white matter fiber bundles directly through complex crossing-fiber regions in Diffusion MRI.

### 3. TractoGPT: A GPT architecture for White Matter Segmentation
- Venue: 23rd IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI 2025, Houston, TX, USA)
- Authors: Anoushkrit Goel, Dr. Aditya Nigam, Dr. Arnav Bhavsar
- ArXiv URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.08187
- Code URL: https://github.com/anoushkrit/TractoGPT
- Page URL: https://anoushkritgoel.com/projects/tractogpt
- SOTA Benchmark Result: Outperformed Sherbrooke Connectivity Imaging Lab (SCIL Canada)'s state-of-the-art model FIESTA.
- Abstract & Method: TractoGPT models 3D tractography streamlines as spatial point cloud tokens. Introduces a dual-masking self-supervised pretraining objective (masking point coordinates within a patch and whole spatial patches across the brain). Fine-tuned on white matter tract anatomical classification.
- BibTeX:
```bibtex
@article{goel2024tractogpt,
  title={TractoGPT: A GPT architecture for White Matter Segmentation},
  author={Goel, Anoushkrit and Nigam, Aditya and Bhavsar, Arnav},
  journal={arXiv preprint arXiv:2411.08187},
  year={2024}
}
```

### 4. TractoEmbed: A Modular Multi-embedding Framework for White Matter Segmentation
- Venue: 27th International Conference on Pattern Recognition (ICPR 2024, Kolkata, India) — Springer
- Authors: Anoushkrit Goel, Dr. Aditya Nigam, Dr. Arnav Bhavsar
- Paper URL: https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-031-78104-9_17
- Code URL: https://github.com/anoushkrit/TractoEmbed
- Page URL: https://anoushkritgoel.com/projects/tractoembed
- SOTA Benchmark Result: Outperformed Harvard Medical School's TractCloud benchmark on white matter tract segmentation.
- Abstract & Method: Extracts multi-scale spatial representations across 3 levels: streamline level (1D CNN), regional patch level (discrete VAE dVAE), and global bundle level (PointNet).
- BibTeX:
```bibtex
@inproceedings{goel2024tractoembed,
  title={TractoEmbed: A Modular Multi-embedding Framework for White Matter Segmentation},
  author={Goel, Anoushkrit and Nigam, Aditya and Bhavsar, Arnav},
  booktitle={International Conference on Pattern Recognition},
  pages={262--278},
  year={2024},
  organization={Springer}
}
```

### 5. Tract-RLformer: A Tract-Specific RL Policy Based Decoder-Only Transformer Network
- Venue: 27th International Conference on Pattern Recognition (ICPR 2024, Kolkata, India) — Springer
- Authors: Anoushkrit Goel, Dr. Aditya Nigam, Dr. Arnav Bhavsar
- Paper URL: https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-031-78201-5_17
- ArXiv URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.05757
- Page URL: https://anoushkritgoel.com/projects/tract-rlformer
- SOTA Benchmark Result: Outperformed SCIL Canada's Track2Learn, DeepTract, and Particle Filtering Tracking (PFT).
- Abstract & Method: Combines supervised pretraining with reinforcement learning policy refinement in an OpenAI Gym environment, directly delineating target fiber tracts without post-processing.
- BibTeX:
```bibtex
@inproceedings{goel2024tract,
  title={Tract-RLFormer: A Tract-Specific RL Policy Based Decoder-Only Transformer Network},
  author={Goel, Anoushkrit and Nigam, Aditya and Bhavsar, Arnav},
  booktitle={International Conference on Pattern Recognition},
  pages={279--295},
  year={2024},
  organization={Springer}
}
```

## Open Source Software & AI Tools

### 1. SlicerTracto
- Category: Standalone 3D Slicer Extension GUI Application
- Code URL: https://github.com/anoushkrit/SlicerTracto
- Page URL: https://anoushkritgoel.com/projects/slicer-tracto
- Description: Culmination of research into an open-source 3D Slicer desktop extension enabling neuro-radiologists to visualize, track, and segment white matter tracts from Diffusion MRI scans with on-prem/cloud GPU compute offloading. Deployed at PGI Chandigarh Hospital.

### 2. Sculpt3D & Talk2point
- Category: Multimodal 3D Generative AI Framework
- Code URL: https://github.com/anoushkrit/Sculpt3D
- Page URL: https://anoushkritgoel.com/projects/sculpt3d
- Description: Multimodal text and sketch-to-3D point cloud generation and interactive region-specific editing framework using SDFusion + LLaMA/GPT continuous feedback loops.
